bug_semantics: getFilenameFromUrl accepts a decoded request pathname when it merely starts with the configured publicPath pathname, rejects dot-dot only when UP_PATH_REGEXP sees `..` as a complete path segment, and then slices the accepted string at publicPathPathname.length before passing the suffix to path.join(outputPath, ...). With a non-slash-terminated publicPath `/assets`, `/assets../.env` passes the prefix check and guard because `..` is embedded in the `assets..` segment, but the slice produces `../.env`, so path.join resolves one directory above outputPath. Disclosure requires the physical filesystem (writeToDisk or a custom outputFileSystem); the default memfs and default publicPath `auto`/`/` do not expose this path, and URL normalization limits this bypass to one parent directory.
flaw_origin: The flaw is the incomplete CVE-2024-29180 remediation developed in PR #1771. The PR's first code member a840f5abc1f49539a7dc8b3d13c3fbec0f090450 added the segment-only UP_PATH_REGEXP check while retaining the boundary-blind startsWith-plus-fixed-offset construction. GitHub later squash-landed the member series as e10008c762e4d5821ed6990348dabf0d4d93a10e; equivalent maintenance-line landings were 9670b3495da518fe667ff3428c5e4cb9f2f3d353 and 189c4ac7d2344ec132a4689e74dc837ec5be0132.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names author and committer `alexander.akait <sheo13666q@gmail.com>`, has the single-line message `fix(security): do not allow to read files above`, contains no Co-Authored-By or Generated-with trailer, and uses no bot identity.
evidence: The first-party prior advisory https://github.com/webpack/webpack-dev-middleware/security/advisories/GHSA-wr3j-pwj9-hqq6 identifies the three CVE-2024-29180 landings e10008c762e4d5821ed6990348dabf0d4d93a10e, 9670b3495da518fe667ff3428c5e4cb9f2f3d353, and 189c4ac7d2344ec132a4689e74dc837ec5be0132 and patched releases 7.1.0, 6.1.2, and 5.3.4. The current advisory https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p3f5-w63m-mxph states that those releases and every later release retain this incomplete-fix bypass and lists no patched version.

PR #1771 (https://github.com/webpack/webpack-dev-middleware/pull/1771) reports base ab533de933c6684218172b86992f35c3ca6c58a4 and head a7a8cf3c7352774e9818aab40df1a439da3894e3. Following each public parent object reconstructs the 14-member chain recorded in decomposed_shas. The landing e10008c762e4d5821ed6990348dabf0d4d93a10e has the same PR title plus `(#1771)` and is the squash aggregate, so it is not the smallest BIC.

The public patch and Git commit API object for a840f5abc1f49539a7dc8b3d13c3fbec0f090450 show parent ab533de933c6684218172b86992f35c3ca6c58a4 and add src/utils/getFilenameFromUrl.js's `UP_PATH_REGEXP`, decode-before-check flow, segment-only traversal rejection, and the prefix-length slice/path.join construction. Direct `git show ab533de933c6684218172b86992f35c3ca6c58a4:src/utils/getFilenameFromUrl.js` confirms that the immediate parent has no UP_PATH_REGEXP and no guarded decoded-path mechanism; it contains the earlier unguarded CVE-2024-29180 implementation instead. Thus the specific incomplete-fix mechanism is absent from the immediate parent tree.

Version membership is exact: `git tag --contains e10008c762e4d5821ed6990348dabf0d4d93a10e` starts at v7.1.0 and continues through v8.1.1; `git tag --contains 9670b3495da518fe667ff3428c5e4cb9f2f3d353` returns v6.1.2 and v6.1.3; `git tag --contains 189c4ac7d2344ec132a4689e74dc837ec5be0132` returns v5.3.4. No earlier tag in those release lines contains its landing.

The validated clone's main tip is 11ea5b0f98f6610cccc6de22d654e343028ca602 (2026-08-09), whose latest reachable release is v8.1.1. At that tip src/middleware.js still defines the segment-only UP_PATH_REGEXP and, at lines 167-195, performs pathname.startsWith(publicPathPathname) followed by path.join(outputPath, pathname.slice(publicPathPathname.length)). Therefore no repository remediation or patched boundary exists as of the audited history, and fix_sha/direct_fix_sha are null.

Only the BIC object was used for AI attribution. https://api.github.com/repos/webpack/webpack-dev-middleware/git/commits/a840f5abc1f49539a7dc8b3d13c3fbec0f090450 reports human author and committer alexander.akait <sheo13666q@gmail.com> and message `fix(security): do not allow to read files above`; the complete message has no trailers or AI marker.
reasoning: GHSA-p3f5-w63m-mxph is the residual one-directory traversal left by the attempted CVE-2024-29180 fix: a boundary-blind publicPath prefix is treated as containment, the regex reasons about dot-dot in the unsliced pathname, and the later fixed-offset slice can manufacture a leading `../` that the guard never evaluated as a segment. I decomposed squash landing e10008c762e4d5821ed6990348dabf0d4d93a10e through PR #1771's public member-parent chain. The first member, a840f5abc1f49539a7dc8b3d13c3fbec0f090450, is the smallest commit that writes the incomplete-fix guard and vulnerable path-building flow; later members debug/refine/test it, while e10008c762e4d5821ed6990348dabf0d4d93a10e is only the squash landing and 9670b3495da518fe667ff3428c5e4cb9f2f3d353/189c4ac7d2344ec132a4689e74dc837ec5be0132 are release-line equivalents. Direct parent-tree inspection proves the new guarded mechanism absent at ab533de933c6684218172b86992f35c3ca6c58a4, and tag containment matches affected boundaries 7.1.0, 6.1.2, and 5.3.4. The vulnerable construction remains in main tip 11ea5b0f98f6610cccc6de22d654e343028ca602 and v8.1.1, so the case is genuinely unpatched rather than missing a discoverable fix. The BIC commit object has a human author/committer and no AI trailer or bot marker, which closes the causal attribution as NOT_AI.
remaining_gap: The vulnerability is still unpatched in the audited public history: no remediation commit, direct fix, or patched release exists through main tip 11ea5b0f98f6610cccc6de22d654e343028ca602 and v8.1.1, so fix_sha and direct_fix_sha necessarily remain null.
